Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We have read your letter carefully and we understand that copper is the driver behind it. Rather than a fixed price that leaves the copper risk with you, we propose to share it through a copper clause with a deadband, so that both sides are protected if the notation moves. In return we need a price basis that reflects the full volume we place with you and the years we have worked together.

We confirm a binding volume of 6110 units a year for the 12-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 348.32 (po:4500014474-10, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014350-20).
Our forecast for this part is up 11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 345.00 per unit, payment 90 days net, price follows CU-NOTATION on 20% of the price, deadband 5%, for our full demand of 6110 units a year over 12 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €351.05 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION.
For your information:
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We acknowledge your proposal and agree to implement the CU-NOTATION index clause to share the material risk.
We have incorporated your verified volume increase into our pricing, but we cannot accept 90 days payment.
We are prepared to extend the payment terms to 60 days net in exchange for a revised unit price of EUR 351.05.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: €349.11 per unit.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
